question.question: In triangle ABC, if angle A = 25°, side a = 11 cm, and side c = 27 cm, is there a valid solution? Explain your reasoning using the sine formula.
question.referenceAnswer: Using the sine formula, \(\frac{27}{\sin C} = \frac{11}{\sin 25^\circ}\), so \(\sin C = \frac{27 \sin 25^\circ}{11} \approx 1.04 > 1\). Since \(\sin C\) cannot be greater than 1, there is no valid solution.
question.evidence: 16. \(A = 25^\circ\), \(a = 11\) cm, \(c = 27\) cm. \(\frac{27}{\sin C} = \frac{11}{\sin 25^\circ}\) \(\Rightarrow \sin C \approx 1.04 > 1\) \(\therefore\) no solution.
